caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, pale pink historical dress with long sleeves and elaborate trimmings. The dress features a fitted bodice, a high neck with a pink ribbon, and a wide skirt that is gathered at the hips, creating a voluminous silhouette. The edges of the bodice, skirt opening, sleeve cuffs, and hem are adorned with vertical ruffled white lace trim, further detailed with small orange floral embroidery. The front panel of the skirt beneath the ruffled opening appears to be a lighter, almost white shade with horizontal pleats or stripes. To the left of the main dress depiction, there is a simplified, lightly sketched view of the dress from the back, showing the gathered skirt and structure. In the upper right section, there is a rectangular inset showing a close-up detail of the lace trim, drawn with intricate horizontal patterns. The background is a plain beige or off-white color. There is a small signature "M. Crimi" in the lower left area.
title: Dress
